item.title: Ballots set for two special legislative races in Georgia
item.description: Six candidates have qualified for the special election to replace former state Rep. Lynn Heffner in House District 130, while four Democrats have signed up to take her place in House District 94, and four candidates have qualified for the Senate District 53 race. item.title: Water leak causes widespread flooding at Fulton County jail
item.description: The Fulton County Sheriff's Office reported that a water leak from a toilet in a third-floor medical unit area caused significant flooding at the Rice Street jail, affecting multiple areas and damaging servers, resulting in a temporary closure of the front lobby and the need for repairs. item.title: Building fire at Dunwoody Crossing Apartments causes massive damage
item.description: A large fire at Dunwoody Village Apartments has displaced dozens of residents and destroyed at least one apartment building, with rescue personnel hampered by an inoperable fire hydrant.
